name: Camel Up (Second Edition)

categories.label: Egyptian Pounds (EP) after final scoring
categories.hint: Count money after the last leg and the overall winner/loser bets are resolved. Winner bets: 8/5/3/2/1 for correct, -1 for wrong; same for loser deck. Money never below 0.

tiebreakers.description: If tied for most money, victory is shared

endCondition.description: Race ends as soon as the first camel crosses the finish line; then final leg scoring and overall winner/loser bets are scored

notes: family: betting-money. Money is tracked during play; leg betting tiles pay 5/3/2 for first place, 1 for second, -1 otherwise; each Pyramid tile gives 1 EP; Desert tile landings give 1 EP.

sources.title: Camel Up (2nd ed) rulebook
sources.section: End of the game; End of the race scoring
